notes.title: Added custom levels to Custom Mode
notes.content:
1. Added custom levels to Custom Mode (players can build their own levels using building blocks).
2. Sound optimizations (including buying, selling, UI clicks, and weapon switching).

notes.title: Optimize the sound effects of attacks
notes.content:
1. Optimize the sound effects of attacks
2. Fix the bug that caused the dialogue to skip quickly
3. Fix the bug that caused the right mouse button to not hold the shield for a long time

notes.title: Fixed the bug
notes.content: Fixed the bug that caused some levels to not move and teammates to not move

notes.title: Objects in the scene can be destroyed
notes.content:
1. Memory is greatly optimized
2. Objects in the scene can be destroyed

notes.title: Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze when the winning condition was change
notes.content: Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze when the winning condition was changed to annihilation.

notes.title: One-click item sorting in backpack and warehouse
notes.content:
1. One-click item sorting in backpack and warehouse
2. Memory optimization, fewer crashes

notes.title: Added soft effects to hair and tail
notes.content:
1. Improved default image quality
2. Added soft effects to hair and tail

notes.title: Improve Xbox controller button prompts
notes.content:
1. You can use the left joystick to control the scroll bar (control the left or right side according to the cursor position)
2. Display the controller button reminder when connecting the controller (previous versions prompted keyboard buttons)

notes.title: Fixed a bug where the cursor disappears and clicking the screen has no effect on
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the cursor disappears and clicking the screen has no effect on the steam deck

notes.title: Fixed the Browning heavy machine gun being unusable bug
notes.content: Fixed the Browning heavy machine gun being unusable bug
